questions.question: If (y + z) = 8 and yz = 6, find the value of (y - z)².
questions.solution:
**Given:**

(y + z) = 8

(yz) = 6

(y - z)² = ?

**Concept used:**

(x - y)² = x² + y² - 2xy

(x + y)² = x² + y² + 2xy

**Calculations:**

According to the question,

(y + z) = 8

Squaring on both sides,

⇒ (y + z)² = (8)²

⇒ y² + 2yz + z² = 64

⇒ y² + 2(6) + z² = 64

⇒ y² + 12 + z² = 64

⇒ y² + z² = 64 - 12

⇒ y² + z² = 52

Now for (y - z)²

(y - z)2 = y² + z² - 2yz

⇒ (y - z)2 = 52 - 2(6)

⇒ (y - z)² = 52 - 12

⇒ (y - z)² = 40

**∴ The value of (y - z)2 is 40.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**(x - y)2 = (x + y)2 - 4xy

(y - z)2 = (y + z)2 - 4yz

(y - z)2 = (8)2 - 4 x 6

(y - z)2 = 40

questions.question: If the difference between the mean and the mode of certain observations is 69, then the difference between the mean and the median is ________.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The **empirical relationship** between central tendencies is: (Mean − Mode) = 3 × (Mean − Median).

Given: Mean − Mode = 69

69 = 3 × (Mean − Median)

⇒ Mean − Median = 69 ÷ 3 = 23

**∴ The correct answer is 23.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Difference between **Mean** and **Mode** (Mean − Mode) = 69.

**Formula Used:** Empirical relation: **Mode = 3 Median − 2 Mean**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dd9b9742537e2d323b385c828b4c3affb390a33b3af7694d9e09f5853b724f2c.png] 

From the given condition: Mean − Mode = 69

⇒ Mode = Mean − 69

Substitute the value of **Mode** in the empirical formula:

⇒ Mean − 69 = 3 Median − 2 Mean

⇒ Mean + 2 Mean − 69 = 3 Median

⇒ 3 Mean − 3 Median = 69

⇒ 3(Mean − Median) = 69

⇒ Mean − Median = 69 ÷ 3

⇒ Mean − Median = 23

**∴ The correct answer is 23.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Empirical Relationship

In a moderately skewed distribution, the relationship is **Mode = 3 Median − 2 Mean** or (Mean − Mode) = 3 (Mean − Median).

Symmetric Distribution

For a perfectly **symmetrical distribution**, the values of Mean, Median, and Mode are all equal (Mean = Median = Mode).

Karl Pearson Coefficient of Skewness

It is calculated as Sₖ = (Mean − Mode) ÷ Standard Deviation, or 3(Mean − Median) ÷ Standard Deviation.</p

questions.question: In an election, 90% of those entitled to vote cast their ballot. 80% of the votes cast was valid. The winner got 60% of the valid votes. If the winner got 64800 votes, what was the number of people entitled to vote?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Let total voters entitled to vote = 100 units

Voters who cast their ballot = 90% of 100 = 90 units

Valid votes = 80% of 90 = 72 units

Winner share = 60% of 72 = 43.2 units

Given: 43.2 units = 64800 ⇒ 1 unit = 1500

Total voters (100 units) = 100 × 1500 = 150,000

**∴ The correct option is D.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Winner's Votes = 64,800

Winner's share = 60% of Valid Votes

Valid Votes = 80% of Votes Cast

Votes Cast = 90% of Total Voters Entitled

**Formula Used:**

Total Voters × Cast % × Valid % × Winner % = Winner's Votes

 
 Total Voters (100%)
 
 Votes Cast (90%)
 
 Valid Votes (80% of 90% = 72%)
 
 Winner (60% of 72% = 43.2%) = 64,800

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the number of people entitled to vote be V.

⇒ Votes cast = 0.90 × V

⇒ Valid votes = 0.80 × (0.90 × V) = 0.72V

⇒ Winner's votes = 0.60 × (0.72V) = 0.432V

⇒ 0.432V = 64800

⇒ V = 64800 ÷ 0.432

⇒ V = 64,800,000 ÷ 432

⇒ V = 150,000

**∴ The correct option is D.**

**__Additional Information__**

Successive Percentage Rule

When a value is changed by a%, b%, and c% successively, the final value = Initial × (a/100) × (b/100) × (c/100).

Election Terms

Valid Votes = Total Votes Cast − Invalid Votes. Winner's Share + Loser's Share = 100% of Valid Votes.

Base Value Identification

Always identify the base for each percentage. Here, 80% was based on votes cast, and 60% was based on valid votes.</p

questions.question: If the mean of numbers 33, x, 47, 83, and 109 is 67, what is the mean of 50, 64, 100, 126, and x?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Total **sum** of the first set = 67 × 5 = 335.

Value of **variable x** = 335 − (33 + 47 + 83 + 109) = 335 − 272 = 63.

Total **sum** of the second set = 50 + 64 + 100 + 126 + 63 = 403.

New **arithmetic mean** = 403 ÷ 5 = 80.6.

**∴ The correct answer is 80.6.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

First set of numbers: 33, x, 47, 83, 109 with **mean** 67.

Second set of numbers: 50, 64, 100, 126, x.

**Formula Used:**

**Arithmetic Mean** = (Sum of all observations) ÷ (Total number of observations)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ce76ef67a56fe2b2fee227c5d799f7b687bf5562f8548fbd3f5d518c448c1f46.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ (33 + x + 47 + 83 + 109) ÷ 5 = 67

⇒ 272 + x = 67 × 5

⇒ 272 + x = 335

⇒ x = 335 − 272 = 63

Now, finding the mean of the **second set**:

⇒ New Set = 50, 64, 100, 126, 63

⇒ Sum = 50 + 64 + 100 + 126 + 63 = 403

⇒ New Mean = 403 ÷ 5

⇒ New Mean = 80.6

**∴ The correct answer is 80.6.**

**__Additional Information__**

Arithmetic Mean Properties

If every observation in a set is increased or decreased by a constant **k**, the **mean** also increases or decreases by **k** respectively.

Sum of Deviations

The algebraic **sum of deviations** of a set of observations from their **arithmetic mean** is always zero.

Combined Mean Formula

For two sets with means M₁ and M₂ and sizes n₁ and n₂, Combined Mean = (n₁M₁ + n₂M₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂).</p

questions.question: The angle of elevation of an aeroplane from a point on the ground is 45°. After a flight of 12 seconds horizontally, the angle of elevation changes to 30°. If the aeroplane is flying at a height of 2400 m, then find the speed of the aeroplane (in m/s).
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For a constant **height (h)**, the **speed** of an **aeroplane** moving horizontally is given by:

**Speed** = [**h** × (cot θ₂ − cot θ₁)] ÷ **Time**

Given: **h** = 2400 m, θ₁ = 45°, θ₂ = 30°, **Time** = 12 s.

⇒ **Speed** = [2400 × (cot 30° − cot 45°)] ÷ 12

⇒ **Speed** = 200 × (√3 − 1)

**∴ The correct answer is 200(√3 − 1) m/s.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Initial **angle of elevation** (θ₁) = 45°

Final **angle of elevation** (θ₂) = 30°

**Height (h)** of the **aeroplane** = 2400 m

**Time duration (t)** = 12 seconds

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/67bf59681fa017a1d8d5dad021c10496d2591acb2cdc20677aba6e191efbc1ef.png] 

Let **x** be the horizontal distance from point **P** to the initial position and **y** be the distance to the final position.

⇒ In the first case: tan 45° = **height** ÷ **x**

⇒ 1 = 2400 ÷ **x** ⇒ **x** = 2400 m

⇒ In the second case: tan 30° = **height** ÷ **y**

⇒ 1/√3 = 2400 ÷ **y** ⇒ **y** = 2400√3 m

⇒ **Distance covered (d)** = **y** − **x** = 2400√3 − 2400 = 2400(√3 − 1) m

⇒ **Speed** = **Distance** ÷ **Time** = 2400(√3 − 1) ÷ 12

⇒ **Speed** = 200(√3 − 1) m/s

**∴ The correct answer is 200(√3 − 1) m/s.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Trigonometric Ratios

questions.question: A train covered a certain distance at a uniform speed. If the train had been 12 km/h faster, it would have taken 8 hours less than the scheduled time. If the train were slower by 12 km/h, the train would have taken 12 hours more than the scheduled time. Find the length of the journey (in km).
questions.solution:
**Given :**

The train takes 8 hours less if its speed is increased by 12 km/h.

The train takes 12 hours more if its speed decreased by 12 km/h.

**Formula used :**

Speed × time = distance

**Calculations : **

Let the speed of the train be x km/h and the time taken be y h.

The total distance is then xy km.

**Case 1:**

Speed increases by 12 km/h and the time taken is reduced by 8 hours. 

The distance traveled remains xy km.

(x + 12) (y − 8) = xy

⇒ xy − 8x + 12y − 96 = xy

⇒ − 8x + 12y − 96 = 0

⇒ − 2x + 3y = 24 ----(1)

**Case 2:**

Speed decreases by 12 km/h, then the time taken increases by 12 hours. 

However, the distance remains xy km.

(x − 12) (y + 12) = xy

⇒ xy + 12x − 12y − 144 =xy

⇒ 12x − 12y − 144 = 0

⇒ x − y = 12 ----(2)

From equation (1) & (2) : 

⇒ x = 60 km/h

Using this in (2), we get

⇒ 60 − y = 12

⇒ y = 48

**∴ The distance is 60 × 48 = 2880 km.**

questions.question: The total surface area of a hemisphere is 108*π cm*². What is the volume of the hemisphere?

⇒ 3πr² = 108π 

⇒ r² = 36

**∴ The volume of the hemisphere is 144π cm3.**

questions.question: Which of the following numbers is NOT divisible by 8?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

To check **divisibility by 8**, we only need to verify if the **last three digits** of the number are divisible by 8.

Checking options: 792 ÷ 8 = 99; 552 ÷ 8 = 69; 112 ÷ 8 = 14; 412 ÷ 8 = 51.5.

Since 412 is not divisible by 8, the entire number **35412** is not divisible by 8.

**∴ The correct answer is 35412.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Four numbers: 35792, 35552, 35112, and 35412.

**Formula Used:** A number is divisible by 8 if and only if the number formed by its **hundreds, tens, and units digits** is divisible by 8.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/abbefbe0fb1273cb7652e20eed47c1f8d704e23c7f868447df6310f6cae59ebd.png] 

Step-by-step verification:

⇒ For 35792: Last 3 digits 792; 792 ÷ 8 = 99 (No remainder).

⇒ For 35552: Last 3 digits 552; 552 ÷ 8 = 69 (No remainder).

⇒ For 35112: Last 3 digits 112; 112 ÷ 8 = 14 (No remainder).

⇒ For 35412: Last 3 digits 412; 412 ÷ 8 = 51 with a **remainder** of 4.

**∴ The correct answer is 35412.**

**__Additional Information__**

Divisibility Rule of 2 and 4

A number is divisible by 2 if its units digit is even. For 4, the last two digits must be divisible by 4.

Divisibility Rule of 16

A number is divisible by 16 if the number formed by its last four digits is divisible by 16.

Divisibility Rule of 3 and 9

A number is divisible by 3 (or 9) if the sum of its digits is divisible by 3 (or 9).</p

questions.question: A and B together can do a piece of work in 10 days. If A alone can do the same work in 15 days and C alone can do the same work in 20 days, then in how many days can B and C together do the same work?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A and B together can do a piece of work in 10 days

A alone can do the same work in 15 days

C alone can do the same work in 20 days

**Calculations:**

According to the question,

⇒ One day work of (A) = 1/15

⇒ One day work of (C) = 1/20

Let the no. of days B alone took to complete the work be 'x'

⇒ One day work of (B) = 1/x

Now A's one-day work + B's one-day work = (A + B) one-day work

⇒ (A) + (B) = (A + B) 

⇒ (1/15) + (1/x) = (1/10)

⇒ (1/x) = (1/10) - (1/15) 

⇒ (1/x) = (15 - 10)/150

⇒ (1/x) = 5/150 

⇒ (1/x) = 1/30 = 30 days

B alone can do the same work in 30 days

Now the work done by B and C together,

B's one-day work + C's one-day work = (B + C) one-day work

⇒ (1/30) + (1/20) = 1/(B + C)

⇒ (2 + 3)/60 = 1/(B + C)

⇒ 5/60 = 1/(B + C)

⇒ 1/(B + C) = 1/12

⇒ (B + C) = 12 days

**∴ B and C together do the same work in 12 days.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__**

The total work = LCM(15, 20, 10) = 60 units (since the work is the same for all).

Efficiency of A = 60 / 15 = 4 units/day

Efficiency of A and B together = Total work / Time taken = 60 / 10 = 6 units/day

Efficiency of B = Efficiency of A and B together - Efficiency of A = 6 - 4 = 2 units/day

Efficiency of C = 60 / 20 = 3 units/day

Combined efficiency of B and C = Efficiency of B + Efficiency of C = 2 + 3 = 5 units/day

Time taken = Total work / Combined efficiency = 60 / 5 = 12 days

**∴ B and C together can complete the work in 12 days.**

questions.question: When was Valmiki Ambedkar Awas Yojana launched?
questions.solution:

__
 
• **Valmiki Ambedkar Awas Yojana (VAMBAY)**

 
 
• It was introduced by the Prime Minister of India on **December 2, 2001.**
 
• It is a** government-funded scheme **for the development of** urban slum dwellers. **
 
• The main goal of this scheme is to improve the** housing problems **for those urban slum dwellers who lives below the poverty line by** providing them with shelters and access to community toilets.**
 
• It aims to raise the living standard of urban slum dwellers by providing them shelters and it also helps to foster a healthy environment by building toilets.
 
• So far, for VAMBAY government had already sanctioned a sum of **Rs.590.00 crore** and have allocated **2,13,066 shelters** as well as **28,753 Toilet Seats.**
 
• The implementation of the scheme VAMBAY is a partnership between the federal and the state governments, with each providing a** contribution of 50%. ​**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In India, other than VAMBAY there are various others schemes for the development of urban slum dwellers such as National Slum Development Programme (NSDP) launched by the Prime Minister of India in August, 1996.
 
• By merging VAMBAY and NSDP an **Integrated Housing and Slum development Programme (IHSDP)** is launched by the government of India with the aim of **providing shelters** and all the **basic facilities to the urban slum dwellers**.

questions.question: The Attorney-General for India is appointed under which Article of the Constitution of India?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **__Article 76__.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Attorney-General of India**

 
 
• In India Attorney-General (AG) is the **chief legal advisor of the Indian government's.**
 
• The **President of India appoints **the AG on the advice of Union Cabinet under **Article 76 **of the** Constitution of India, 1950.**
 
• **The Attorney-General have an advisory role to counsel the government of India in the legal matters and their positions are hold as per the President's pleasure. **This indicates that there is no specific tenure, and that they serve until the President appoints their removal. 
 
• In addition to serving as the government's primary legal counsel, the AG of India should also appears in the Supreme Court on behalf of the government.
 
• In India, there have been **16 AGs **since 1950.** R Venkatramaniis the current attorney general** of India. In 2023, President Draupadi Murmu appointed him.. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• The Attorney-General of India is also a **first law officer of the country**.
 
• **Motilal Chimanlal Setalvad** was appointed as the first attorney-general of India. His tenure as attorney general from **1950 to 1963** is still the longest tenure served by any attorney-general.
 
• The AGs has the** right of audience** to appear in **all Indian Court's **and to take part in the Parliamentary sessions, **but not to vote**.
 
• The Attorney General of India lacks executive authority, in contrast to the** Attorney General of the United States**. The Law Minister of India is the in charge of certain duties.
